segmentation.text: It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate
a vehicle of any kind or character
A rate of speed greater than
that posted by a public authority
for the particular portion of highway being traversed.

elements.justification: "drive or operate" is read through the vehicle's controlled motion: kin.speed, "magnitude of velocity", the motion the duty judges; the same words map to kin.speed in the run's index.

"a vehicle of any kind or character": the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, "every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway", whatever its class.
The rate of speed is kin.speed, "magnitude of velocity" (m/s), compared strictly greater than the posted value.

The speed posted: dev.speed_limit_sign, "sign stating a maximum or minimum speed, with value and unit", of kind maximum, structure_maximum or zone, read as the value dev_speed_limit_sign_value (m/s). "Public authority" (DEF-NRS-484A-195, "the Department of Transportation or the local authority having jurisdiction") is the sign's legal source, read from the sign's presence.

The particular portion of highway being traversed is the travel region (st.travel_region) the subject's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) that the sign governs (dev.governs, "the travel regions whose traffic the device controls"). dev.governs is "not a stand-in for a position": no halt place is read from it, only which portion the posting covers.

applicability: The subject is a vehicle whose footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) a travel region r governed (dev.governs) by a dev.speed_limit_sign of kind maximum, structure_maximum or zone.
obligation: For every such sign d governing a travel region the subject occupies, kin.speed(subject) is not greater than dev_speed_limit_sign_value(d).

narrowings.why: "drive or operate" is read through the vehicle's controlled motion, whoever or whatever controls it.
That the speed is posted by a public authority is read from the presence of the speed limit sign.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A maximum speed limit sign of 20.1 m/s governs the lane the subject car occupies; kin.speed is 24 m/s.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: No speed limit sign governs any region the subject car occupies.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A maximum sign governs the subject's lane; the source does not supply kin.speed.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: Only a minimum speed limit sign governs the subject's lane; the subject travels faster than its value.
